summary: Search and category filter on the catalog page
description: Visitors to /catalog should be able to narrow the list by typing a search term and by choosing a category. Builds on DEMO-1.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: /catalog has a text search that filters products by name and description, case-insensitively, as the visitor types.
AC2: /catalog has a category filter (all + one option per category) that combines with the search.
AC3: The filter state is reflected in the URL query string so a filtered view can be shared.
AC4: Unit tests cover the filtering function, including combined search + category and the empty-result message.
guidance: Keep the page statically rendered; do filtering on the client in a small client component.
Do not add a UI library; use the existing Tailwind classes.
